book.mohorses.guide.name: Mo' Horses Guide
book.mohorses.guide.tooltip: Everything about zebras, magic horses and the undead
book.mohorses.guide.welcome.title: Mo' Horses
book.mohorses.guide.welcome.text:
Mo' Horses brings the horse breeding of **Mo' Creatures** back: zebras, Zorses and Zonkeys, Nightmares, Unicorns, Pegasi and Fairy Horses, the undead and their ghosts.

It all starts with a **Zebra**. Cross it with a horse, feed essences to the foal and work your way up to the magic horses.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.welcome.name: Welcome
book.mohorses.guide.taming_zebras.entity: Zebras live in **savannas, badlands and deserts**.
book.mohorses.guide.taming_zebras.title: Taming
book.mohorses.guide.taming_zebras.text:
A wild Zebra can't be ridden. Ride a black-and-white horse up to it instead: **black with white dots**, **black with a white field** or **white with black dots**.

From its back, feed the Zebra **Sugar Lumps**. Each one tames it with a 1 in 3 chance. A tamed Zebra takes a saddle, but no chest and no armor.
Sugar Lumps and the right horse
book.mohorses.guide.above_the_clouds.tex:
Some essences only work high up: the **Bat Horse**, the **Pegasus** and the **Dark Pegasus** need the horse to stand **on the ground**, at least **4 blocks above the clouds**.

Build a platform up there, lead your horse onto it and feed the essence while it stands still.
book.mohorses.guide.zorse.entity: Breed a tamed Zebra with a horse, both fed golden apples or carrots.
book.mohorses.guide.zorse.title: The Start
book.mohorses.guide.zorse.text:
Any horse coat works. The Zorse is **sterile**, but it is where all the magic horses begin: you'll want more than one.

Zebras, Nightmares, Bat Horses and Unicorns also breed their own kind.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.zorse.name: Zorse
book.mohorses.guide.zonkey.entity: Breed a tamed Zebra with a donkey.
book.mohorses.guide.zonkey.title: Stubborn
book.mohorses.guide.zonkey.text: A **sterile** cross that carries a chest but no armor. If a tamed Zonkey dies, it may come back as a Ghost Horse.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.zonkey.name: Zonkey
book.mohorses.guide.nightmare.entity: Feed a tamed Zorse an Essence of Fire.
book.mohorses.guide.nightmare.title: Fire Horse
book.mohorses.guide.nightmare.text:
Nightmares are **immune to fire** and wear no armor. Feed one **redstone**: for a minute it runs faster and leaves a trail of fire.

Wild Nightmares roam the Nether. They attack on sight, can't be tamed, and now and then a Piglin Brute rides one.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.nightmare.name: Nightmare
book.mohorses.guide.unicorn.entity: Feed a tamed Nightmare an Essence of Light.
book.mohorses.guide.unicorn.title: Horn and Stars
book.mohorses.guide.unicorn.text:
Unicorns **glide** down slowly with a trail of stars and take no fall damage. Crack a **whip** while riding one and it charges, head down: only then does its horn hurt.

They fall in love with Essence of Light and drop their horn when they die.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.unicorn.name: Unicorn
book.mohorses.guide.bat_horse.entity: Feed a tamed Zorse an Essence of Darkness, standing on the ground above the clouds.
book.mohorses.guide.bat_horse.title: First Wings
book.mohorses.guide.bat_horse.text: The first horse that **flies**: jump to take off, keep jumping to climb. It falls in love with Essence of Darkness.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.bat_horse.name: Bat Horse
book.mohorses.guide.entry.bat_horse.desc: Zorse + Essence of Darkness, above the clouds
book.mohorses.guide.pegasus.entity: Feed a tamed Bat Horse an Essence of Light above the clouds.
book.mohorses.guide.pegasus.title: White Wings
book.mohorses.guide.pegasus.text: A white, flying horse that falls in love with Essence of Light. It goes in the **Sky Amulet**.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.pegasus.name: Pegasus
book.mohorses.guide.entry.pegasus.descri: Bat Horse + Essence of Light, above the clouds
book.mohorses.guide.dark_pegasus.entity: Feed a tamed Pegasus an Essence of Darkness above the clouds.
book.mohorses.guide.dark_pegasus.title: Black Wings
book.mohorses.guide.dark_pegasus.text: Flies, is **immune to fire** and falls in love with Essence of Darkness. With a Unicorn it breeds a black Fairy Horse.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.dark_pegasus.d: Pegasus + Essence of Darkness, above the clouds
book.mohorses.guide.fairy_horse.entity: Breed a Unicorn with a Pegasus (white) or a Dark Pegasus (black), each fed its essence.
book.mohorses.guide.fairy_horse.title: A Costly Foal
book.mohorses.guide.fairy_horse.text:
The parents are used up: the Unicorn is gone (its gear drops), the Pegasus comes back in a **Sky Amulet**. Two Fairy Horses breed another one, but both vanish.

Every Fairy Horse can be **dyed once** with any dye; white dye makes it white again.
book.mohorses.guide.hearts.spotlight: Hearts only drop when **a player** makes the kill; Looting raises the chance.
book.mohorses.guide.hearts.title: Who Drops What
book.mohorses.guide.hearts.text:
**Heart of Darkness:** endermen, endermites, bats, phantoms and wither skeletons; always the Warden, the Wither and the Ender Dragon.

**Heart of Fire:** blazes, ghasts, magma cubes, striders and wild Nightmares.

**Heart of Undead:** zombies of every kind, zoglins, zombie horses, camel husks and zombie nautiluses.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.hearts.name: Hearts
book.mohorses.guide.essences.title: Four Essences
book.mohorses.guide.essences.text:
Each essence is crafted from a heart, one more ingredient and a glass bottle. The **Essence of Light** is made from the other three.

Feed an essence to your tamed, grown horse: it stands still in a cloud of particles for a few seconds and comes out changed.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.essences.name: Brewing Essences
book.mohorses.guide.entry.essences.descr: A heart, an ingredient and a bottle
book.mohorses.guide.paths.title: Changes
book.mohorses.guide.paths.text:
**Fire:** Zorse → Nightmare.
**Darkness (above the clouds):** Zorse → Bat Horse, Pegasus → Dark Pegasus.
**Light:** Nightmare → Unicorn; above the clouds Bat Horse → Pegasus; skeletons get their flesh back.
**Undead:** see the chapter on the undead.

An essence a horse doesn't change from heals it instead, if it is the right one.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.paths.name: Which Essence Does What
book.mohorses.guide.entry.paths.descript: All the changes at a glance
book.mohorses.guide.undead_horses.entity: Unicorns and Fairy Horses become **Undead Unicorns**, winged horses **Undead Pegasi**.
book.mohorses.guide.undead_horses.title: Undead
book.mohorses.guide.undead_horses.text:
Zebras, Zorses, Zonkeys, Nightmares and vanilla horses, donkeys and mules become **zombie horses**.

Undead horses with flesh on them **burn in daylight**. Monsters leave you alone while you ride any undead horse. Only zombie horses wear armor, and Essence of Undead heals them.
book.mohorses.guide.decay.entity: Maggots wiggle around harmlessly and drop slime balls.
book.mohorses.guide.decay.title: Rotting Away
book.mohorses.guide.decay.text:
Every 4 minutes an undead horse loses another patch of flesh and a **maggot** crawls out. After 5 stages only a **skeleton** is left, keeping its owner and saddle. Skeletons don't burn.

Maggots also crawl out of **composters**: every item put in has a 1 in 64 chance to bring one out.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.decay.name: Decay and Maggots
book.mohorses.guide.revival.title: Flesh Again
book.mohorses.guide.revival.text: Feed a skeleton an **Essence of Light** and it gets its flesh back: a Skeleton Unicorn becomes a Unicorn, a Skeleton Pegasus a Pegasus and a skeleton horse a horse again.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.revival.name: Second Life
book.mohorses.guide.entry.revival.descri: Essence of Light on a skeleton
book.mohorses.guide.ghosts.entity: Pale, see-through and flickering, ghosts hover with their legs swept back.
book.mohorses.guide.ghosts.title: A Second Chance
book.mohorses.guide.ghosts.text:
When a tamed **Zorse, Zonkey, Nightmare or Unicorn** dies, there is a 1 in 10 chance it comes back as your **Ghost Horse**. A **Bat Horse, Pegasus, Dark Pegasus or Fairy Horse** comes back as a **Ghost Pegasus** instead.

Ghosts go in the Ghost Amulet.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.ghosts.name: Ghost Horses
book.mohorses.guide.amulets.spotlight: Use an empty amulet on your animal to put it in, saddle, armor and chest included. Use the full one on a block to let it out.
book.mohorses.guide.amulets.title: Which Amulet
book.mohorses.guide.amulets.text:
**Sky Amulet:** Pegasus and Dark Pegasus.
**Fairy Amulet:** Fairy Horses.
**Bone Amulet:** the undead, also vanilla zombie and skeleton horses and zombie nautiluses.
**Ghost Amulet:** ghosts.
**Pet Amulet:** every other tamed animal of yours.

Only the owner can put an animal in, and only a grown one. Hold **Alt** over a full amulet to see the animal.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.amulets.name: Amulets
book.mohorses.guide.whip.title: Crack!
book.mohorses.guide.whip.text: Crack the whip while riding a **Unicorn** and it lowers its head and charges for two seconds: everything its horn meets takes 10 damage. Crack it at a creature and the unicorn charges at that one.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.whip.name: Whip
book.mohorses.guide.crystal_armor.title: Crystal
book.mohorses.guide.crystal_armor.text:
Bat Horses, Unicorns, Pegasi, Dark Pegasi, Fairy Horses and the ghosts wear **only** Crystal Horse Armor. It protects like netherite horse armor and is made from it.

Zebras, Zonkeys, Nightmares and the undead Unicorns and Pegasi wear no armor at all.
book.mohorses.guide.shuffling.title: Dance!
book.mohorses.guide.shuffling.text: Use any music disc on a Zebra and it turns into the **Shuffling** disc. Play it in a jukebox and every Zebra nearby starts to dance.
book.mohorses.guide.entry.shuffling.name: Shuffling
